metric_definitions.canonical_name: ESRS S1-16 highest-paid individual / median employee remuneration ratio
metric_definitions.definition: Reported ESRS S1-16 ratio between annual total remuneration of the highest-paid individual and median annual employee remuneration; source-defined scope is preserved and not silently normalized.
metric_definitions.denominator_definition: Median annual total remuneration of employees under the reporting source definition.
metric_definitions.numerator_definition: Annual total remuneration of the highest-paid individual, as defined by the reporting source.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: ERGO Group IFRS 17 contractual service margin
metric_definitions.definition: Source-reported ERGO Group contractual service margin under IFRS 17. CSM represents future-service profit in insurance liabilities and must not be relabelled as Embedded Value or Value of New Business.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: Munich Re financed GHG emissions — reported actual
metric_definitions.definition: Source-reported financed Scope 1+2 emissions for the Climate Ambition 2025 investment scope; source methodology caveats remain in observation dimensions.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: Munich Re financed GHG emissions — nominal-value sensitivity
metric_definitions.definition: Source-reported sensitivity showing the reduction that would result from using nominal values for debt instruments instead of the primary Climate Ambition 2025 market-value method.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: Munich Re financed GHG emissions — 2019 baseline
metric_definitions.definition: Source-reported 2019 financed Scope 1+2 emissions baseline for the Climate Ambition 2025 investment scope.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: Munich Re financed GHG emissions — reported reduction
metric_definitions.definition: Source-reported percentage reduction versus 2019 using the Climate Ambition 2025 methodology, including its market-value treatment for debt instruments.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: Munich Re financed GHG target reduction — lower bound
metric_definitions.definition: Source-reported lower bound of Munich Re Climate Ambition 2025 financed Scope 1+2 emissions reduction target versus the 2019 base year for the disclosed investment scope.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: Munich Re financed GHG target reduction — upper bound
metric_definitions.definition: Source-reported upper bound of Munich Re Climate Ambition 2025 financed Scope 1+2 emissions reduction target versus the 2019 base year for the disclosed investment scope.
Source-reported Climate Ambition 2025 target for renewable-energy investments by market value. This metric is the target amount; no actual investment amount is inferred.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: Munich Re tax-transparency CbCR current income tax
metric_definitions.definition: Country/aggregate current income tax as published in Munich Re Tax Transparency Report 2024; does not silently include deferred or other-period taxes.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: Munich Re tax-transparency CbCR employee count
metric_definitions.definition: Source-reported country/aggregate employee count in Munich Re Tax Transparency Report 2024. This is a persons count and must not be treated as FTE.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: Munich Re tax-transparency CbCR expected corporate tax rate
metric_definitions.definition: Expected corporate tax rate as published in Munich Re Tax Transparency Report 2024; source N/A is preserved as NOT_APPLICABLE.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: Munich Re tax-transparency CbCR paid income tax
metric_definitions.definition: Country/aggregate paid income tax as published in Munich Re Tax Transparency Report 2024.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: Munich Re tax-transparency CbCR profit before tax
metric_definitions.definition: Country/aggregate profit before tax as published in Munich Re Tax Transparency Report 2024. Displayed monetary values are rounded to full EUR millions.

metric_definitions.canonical_name: Munich Re tax-transparency CbCR published effective tax rate
metric_definitions.definition: Effective tax rate exactly as published by Munich Re. It is a source fact and must not be recomputed from rounded displayed PBT and tax values.
Source-reported Solvency II ratio. Entity scope and treatment of transitional/LTG measures are preserved in observation dimensions; values with different treatments must not be silently ranked.
